entries.00be7b6a2f540169: As Phase 3 (from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026) of its management vision "Vision2025," the company sets out as priority measures "creation of new corporate value," "promotion of growth strategies," and "rebuilding a solid management foundation." Along with deepening its mainstay residential field, it will develop sales activities in non-residential fields, overseas sales, and new fields, and, amid an expected contraction of the housing market over the medium to long term, it intends to further promote growth strategies and shift to a highly profitable structure through cost reduction activities and other measures. As medium- to long-term management priorities, it sets out matters such as building a stable earnings base centered on the interior decoration-related business.
